instruction: Two Storey Community Center IFC This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a Revit community center with a central atrium, classrooms, a maker room, and two roof elements, then save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes. 2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 7 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 5 IfcSlab entities, and 2 IfcRoof entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 5 IfcDoor entities, at least 8 IfcWindow entities, and at least 2 IfcStair entities. 6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities. 7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token classroom at least 2 times, maker at least once, lobby at least once, toilet at least once, and gallery at least 2 times. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 20.0 m and 24.0 m. 9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 18.5 m and 22.0 m. 10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 6.7 m and 8.0 m. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
